_schema: pyjanus resource-atlas output/garbage annotations v1 (see README.md and docs/output-annotation.md)

roles.output: intended result; expected non-zero at termination
roles.input: input data; expected unchanged from its initial value at termination
roles.garbage: not an intended result, left non-zero at termination (logs, retained intermediates). Stacks may say 'garbage (reversibility log)' -- the loader keeps the first word.
roles.scratch: intended to be all-zero / empty at termination (uncomputed, consumed, or never written)

programs.rationale: Header: 'uncall delete re-inserts the key and restores the exact tree'; the four node arrays ARE the tree (output); the deleted node 5 'is left detached as reversible garbage' inside them; alog/hlog/rlog/dlog are overwrite/decision logs.

Header: 'result is the balanced AVL tree, root = node 4'; node arrays are the output data structure; 'alog -- old child/root pointers', 'hlog -- old node heights', 'rlog -- one rotation code per visited node' are logs.
Header: 'leaving only res (Bennett compute-copy-uncompute)'; tree arrays are read-only input; res5=5, res8=0.
Header: 'the map (n,b) |-> digits is injective'; n,b read-only scalars, d holds the digits 6,2,0,2.
Header: 'outputs: dist[], pred[], and the logs dlog/plog/rlog'; the edge lists are read-only input; logs hold overwritten values / decision bits.
Header: 'outputs: dist[], visited[], queue[] (visit order), blog'; adj read-only; head/tail are queue pointers (not counted as outputs).
main comments: 'garbage for each extractmin' / 'garbage for each insert's decreasekey'; A is the heap after 6 extracts + 5 re-inserts; min1..min6 are the extracted minima.
Header: 'x & y = 8, x | y = 14, x ^ y = 6'; x,y inputs.
Header 'bubble sort with optimal garbage'; a sorted in place, ord = permutation recovered by 'uncall bsort(ord,sz,gb)', which also empties the 'garbage stack' gb.
Header: 'the map (x,y) |-> z is injective'; pair(3,5)=41 in z, x,y read-only.
Header: 'forward: res = min over i<j of ...'; fold 'uncalled to erase the logs'.
res = C(5,2); n,r inputs.

main: gcd_clean is a Bennett wrapper (computes, copies g, uncomputes) so log returns to zero after every call; first call is uncalled (g=0), g2=7 and g3=9 remain.

main: case A 'uncall scatters the elements back, restoring the input and clearing flags'; case B is not uncalled: b partitioned in place (unchanged since already ordered), q=3, flags_b left as the decision log.
